title: Change the hydration route
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Hydroboration followed by oxidation gives the non-Markovnikov alcohol. The OH group is on propene’s terminal carbon, so the product is 1-propanol.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of propene under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Propene is treated with 1. BH₃·THF; 2. H₂O₂, OH⁻. Which major organic product forms after workup? Hydroboration followed by oxidation gives the non-Markovnikov alcohol. The OH group is on propene’s terminal carbon, so the product is 1-propanol.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
